name: Wilderness
english_description: A production game built on the LIMA mudlib codebase (v1.0a9) -- the same FluffOS-project reference framework already onboarded standalone as libs/lima, but this is an independent, much older (May 2000) snapshot with AUTO_WIZ disabled, so real players start as mortals in a real game world rather than as wizards in a framework demo. Centralized natural-language command parsing, a capability-based security daemon, wizard Unix-like shells, Intermud-3 support, and an elaborate modular combat system (death/health/wield/armor/pulse/blows/formula/advancement submodules). Same Harvey Mudd College academic hosting (cs.hmc.edu) as libs/lpmud141, though an unrelated codebase from a different era of that department's LPMud hosting.
